name: Admin Accounting Card Snapshots
description: Superuser manages weekly credit-card balance snapshots at /panel/accounting/cards: list with latest-debt-per-card chip, filters (date range, debt range, card multi-select), create via modal (date defaults to today, card picked from a dropdown fed by the CreditCard catalog; the Deuda input is gone — debt is server-computed as cupo − disponible and previewed in the form, which blocks disponible > cupo), edit prefill (legacy names outside the catalog injected as an extra option) and delete with ConfirmModal. Registering a snapshot dated on/after the cycle Friday silences the weekly card-debt email reminder. The card filter defaults to the active catalog cards as removable chips (clearing them surfaces historical names); its options are the union of catalog and snapshot names, and a saved tab in the URL wins over the preselection. Row actions follow the panel standard: a leading three-dot menu with no visible header opens a modal with Detalle e historial, Editar and Eliminar. The Notas column no longer prints the note: it shows a 'Ver nota' button (or '—' when empty) that opens the full note in a modal, with the active search highlighted. At phone and portrait widths the visible columns fill the table with no blank band and the table fits without horizontal scroll.
